Dimension.name: $~uî-tō
doc: $~Guá sī /tan-uī/!
Guá ē-sái sī jīm-hô piau-tsún tan-uī, ná-ūn \1m\, \10s\, \100g\, iah-sī jīm-hô kî-thuann ê kho-ha̍k tan-uī. Guá mā iōng-ē-tiāu lí ka-tī siūnn ê tan-uī, ná-ūn \17apple\.
Guá ē-sái kap \/\ kap-hô tsò pí-lī tan-uī, ná-ūn \17apple/day\, mā ē-sái kap \^\ kap-hô tsò tsū-hông tan-uī, ná-ūn \9.8m/s^2\
Guá tio̍h-ài kui-tsūn tī @Number ê āu-bīn. Nā m̄-sī án-ne, guá ē hōo lâng kóng-tsò @Reference, hit-tang tō ū-tsit-ê khùn-nn̄g!
Guá mā kài kuè-hóo tshōe tan-uī tsiong-kan ê m̄-kah. Pí-lūn kóng, \1cat + 1dog\🪲 sī bô-tó-lí ê!
Nā lí siūnn-beh tī put-tông @values ê tan-uī tsiong-kan tsuán-uānn, tsiah khì tshōe @Convert.

7\

Lí mā ē-sái kā guá khǹg tī @Program siōng thâu-chêng, kóng-tsit-ê piáu-ián kàu-té teh kóng siánn-mih:

\¶Tsit ê thîng-sik kóng halo¶

'lí-hó!'\
Lí ē-sái hōo guá tsi̍t-ê @Language, tsān-tsān pa̍t-lâng bat guá sī ēng siánn-mih gí-giân siá ê:

\¶Guá sī Eng-gí ê suat-bîng¶
duration: 5s\🪲

Lí bián tsò siánn-mih tèh-pia̍t ê tāi-tsì tsiah ē-tàng tsò list. Kan-tan kā tsiann-tsiann @Doc khǹg tī sio-tsi̍h, án-ne:

\¶Halo¶
greeting: '…'\🪲

KeyValue.name: $~tuì-ìng
doc: $~Guá sī tsi̍t-ê tuì-ìng, ùi tsi̍t-ê *kiān* tuì kàu tsi̍t-ê *ta̍t*, lóng tī @Map lāi-té.

Iā-sī ùi bûn-jī tuì kàu sò-jī ê tuì-ìng:

Language.name: $~gí-giân
doc: $~Guá sī tsi̍t-ê @language piau-ki, guá kap @Name kap @Doc tsò-hóe tsò-kang!

Guá tsiok kam-tsūn ē-sái hōo lí *khuànn-liáu tsin-tsheng-tshó* tsi̍t-kù ōe sī iōng siánn-mih gí-giân siá ê. Tsí-ū tsi̍t-ê siòng-sian kap kuí-ê jī-bú, tō bē ū lâng bē-tsai-iánn tsit-tuānn jī sī siánn-mih gí-giân.
Pí-uí kóng, lí beh kóng "Language", ǹ-koh beh hōo lâng bat sī iōng Eng-gí:
\'Gí-giân'/nan\
Lí ē-sái tuì @Name án-ne tsò:
\sia: 'niau'\🪲
…hia̍h-sī tuì @Doc:

\¶Siong-siann-tsu¶
sia: 'niau'\🪲

Û-sî-á bûn-jī m̄-sī tsí-ū tsi̍t-khuán gí-giân — sī *tsham-tsa*. Tshiūnn Spanglish, Se-pan-gâ-gí kap Eng-gí kui-ê tsham-tsa. Án-ne ê tāi-tsì, ta̍k-ê gí-giân tiong-kan iōng ke-sàⁿ ê tē-á-sian-suànn (underscore) kā-hun. Tē-it-ê sī *tsú-iàu* ê — guá tio̍h-ài kéng ê sî, tō iōng ê sī án-ne (pí-uí kéng beh iōng siánn-mih ìn-hō).
\"Hola gentleman!"/es_en\

\¶Lióng-ê gí-giân ê the-gua¶
hello/es_en: 'Hola gentleman!'\🪲

Tsham-tsa ê piau-ki sī kóng kui-ê bûn-jī sī tsham-tsa ê, in-uī án-ne bān-bīn tuì-tāi-khì @Say ē-sái iōng tsú-iàu gí-giân kā tsuân-pōo tiō-tshut-lâi. Beh hōo múi-ê jī iōng ka-kī ê gí-giân tiō, tio̍h kā jī ta̍k-ê piau-ki, ànn-āu koh kap-tsò-hóe:
\"Hola "/es + 'gentleman!'/nan\
Lí mā ē-sái ke-thiam tsi̍t-ê @region, tī tsi̍t-ê ham-hō āu-bīn, kap tsi̍t-khuán gí-giân kāng-khuán:
\"Hola gentleman!"/es_en-MX\
Gí-giân ê sò-liōng bô hān-tsè — tsí-ū m̄-thang tsìng-hok kāng-khuán ê; nā-sī lí án-ne tsò, guá ē kā lí kóng.

Lí ē-sái iōng <2 ê jī-bú ê tāi-bé@https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_639-1_codes> hia̍h-sī iōng gí-giân ê *miâ* lâi siá, iōng hit-khuán gí-giân hia̍h-sī iōng Eng-gí lóng ē-sái — `/es`, `/Español`, kap `/Spanish` lóng sī kāng-khuán ê ì-sù, `/es-MX`, `/es-México`, kap `/es-Mexico` mā sī. Tuā-siá kap im-tiāu-hû-hō bô koan-hē, in-uī án-ne `/ESPANOL` mā ē-sái. Nā-sī miâ lāi-té ū khòng-keh, tio̍h siá bô khòng-keh, pí-uí `/BahasaIndonesia`, in-uī tsi̍t-ê piau-ki sī kui-ê tsi̍t-ê jī. Nā-sī guá bô tsāi-iánn gí-giân hia̍h-sī tē-khu, guá ē kā lí kóng.

doc: $~Guá piáu-tsi̍t-ê @value, sī tsi̍t-ê ū-iōng ê hong-huat, kā hui-siông oh tsú-tsò ê mih, iā-sī lí m̄-bián tsāi-tsāi tsò ê mih, hōo tsi̍t-ê kán-tan ê miâ-piau.
@Bind án-ne hōo guá miâ:
Guá tsí-ē-sái tsit-tsi̍t-ê ta̍t, tsì-ê tsiū-tsāi-tsāi bē-tàng kái. Pí-ká, nā-sī lí kā @Bind án-ne tsò, guá-lán ē khiàn-khiàn.

\hāi: 5
hāi2: 3\🪲
Lí beh tit-tio̍h guá ê ta̍t, tsí-ū @Reference iā-sī @PropertyReference ēng tsit-ê miâ. Tsia, @Bind kā guá kiò-miâ, jiân-āu @Reference tit-tio̍h guá ê ta̍t.

\hāi: 5
hāi\

In-uī @Bind ē tshut-hiān tī hui-siông tsē ê tē-hng, guá mā ē tshut-hiān tī hui-siông tsē ê tē-hng. Guá téng-bīn tī tsi̍t-ê @Block lāi-té, m̄-koh guá mā ē tī tsi̍t-ê @FunctionDefinition lāi-té. Tsia guá teh án-tsuánn kā tsi̍t-ê sìn-sit tsām-sî kiò-miâ:
\ƒ kóng(message•'') message\
Guá tī @FunctionDefinition lāi-té tīng-gī, jiân-āu hâm-sò tsiah tsūn khàu-bue, guá tō lī-khui.
Lí ē-sái ēng @Language lâi piáu-bîng guá ê miâ sī siánn-mih gí-giân. Tng lí kap pa̍t-lâng hun-hióng lí ê piáu-ián, nā-sī in beh tha̍k lí ê Program, tsit-ê ē ū-iōng.

\¶Guá sī ū *tshu* jī ê suat-bîng bûn-kiānn. Guá ē-tàng kóng tio̍h @Phrase chit-lūi ê khuan-liām. Guá ē-tàng liân kàu <bāng-lō͘ téng ê tāi-tsì@https://wordplay.dev>.¶

)\

Paragraph.name: $~tsiuⁿ-lo̍h
doc: $~Guá sī @Words、@ConceptLink、@WebLink kap @Example ê it-tsuè, tiong-kan ēng khang-pe̍h ê tsi̍t-hâng lâi hun-khai, koh tī @Doc lāi-té.
Lí beh siá guá, tsí-ū tī @Doc siá tsi̍t-tīnn ê ōe tō hó:
\¶Guá sī bûn-kiānn lāi-té ê tsi̍t-tsiat.¶'tsi̍t-tsiat'\
Nā-sī beh tsē-tsē tsiuⁿ-lo̍h, tō tī tiong-kan thiⁿ khang-pe̍h ê tsi̍t-hâng.

\¶Tē 1 tsiat.

Tē 2 tsiat.

\¶Guá sī bûn-kiānn lāi-té ê <link@https://wordplay.dev>¶
'link ê lē-tsú'\
Nā ū lâng kná guá, guá ē khui sin ê thang-á kàu hit-ê URL.

ConceptLink.name: $~jîn-bu̍t
doc: $~Guá sī liân-kiat khì Verse jī-guân ê link. Lí beh siá @Doc, koh beh kóng-tio̍h guán tsit-tsi̍t ê, guá tsiū ū-iōng.
Pí-phuànn kóng, lí beh kóng @Evaluate, koh kóng i guā-nī kiōng. Lí ē-sái án-ne siá:

\¶Lí tsai, @Evaluate chiâⁿ hó.¶
'Khòaⁿ, tsi̍t-ê jī-goân ê link!'\
Jī-guân mā ū Unicode hō-má. Pí-phuànn kóng, @FunctionDefinition sī 192. Lí ē-sái siá @U/ kah i ê hō-má, tsiū ē tshut-hiān tsit ê jī-guân:
\`@U/192 chiâⁿ súi!`\
Nā-sī lí ka-kī tsò jī-guân, mā ē-sái iōng lí tshi̍h hō i ê miâ lâi kóng-tio̍h i.
\`@coolbeans/cat`\
Oh... Tsit ê jī-guân bô-tsāi, in-uī án-ne tsiah ū tsi̍t ê sió sì-hông-á. Nā ū, i tsiū ē tshut-hiān tī tsia!

Words.name: $~jī
doc: $~Guá sī lí tī @Doc nih beh siá ê jī-ku. Pí-phuànn kóng:

\¶Būn Force kap lí tsòe-hué.¶
'Kan-na tsi̍t-kuá jī!'\
Û-sî lí koh beh iōng @Doc ê te̍k-piạt jī-guân /lâi/ tsò jī-ku. Pí-phuànn kóng:

\¶Guá ê pêng-iú ē iōng 、//、**、||, kah kî-tha hû-hō.¶
'iōng the̍k-pia̍t ê jī-goân!'\
Nā-sī lí kan-tan tīng-ho̍k siá tsiah-ê te̍k-piạt jī-guân, tsiū ē tshut-hiān tsit ê jī-guân, m̄-sī i ê te̍k-piạt ì-sù.

BinaryEvaluate.name: $~nn̄g-ê ín-sòo ê khuànn-hōo
doc: $~Guá sī @Evaluate, put-kò iōng khah kán-tan ê hîng-sik, lí beh iōng tsi̍t-ê tsiap-siu nn̄g-ê @argument ê @FunctionDefinition ê sî-tsūn tsiū ū-iōng.
Pí-phuànn kóng, @Evaluate ē-sái án-ne kā nn̄g-ê sò-jī ka:
Khuànn-khí-lâi bô tsiok-tshiūnn, lí kám-ū? Tse bô tshò: i kan-tan kóng tāi-seng ná 1 ê add hâm-sik, liân-sûn lâi sǹg.
Nā-sī iōng @BinaryEvaluate khah khuì-lia̍t
Án-ne tāi-ke lóng khah tsíng-lí, sui-bóng tsit-ê pún-tsiah sī tsit-khuán.
Tsí-ū tsi̍t-kâng tio̍h tsù-ì: guá tī tsit-ê hîng-sik ê sî, sī tsò-tsîng tsiàm ê tsūn-sī lâi sǹg. Nā-sī lí kuàn-sì sò-ha̍k ê sǹg-sū sūn-sī, tse khó-lîng ē hō lí hôo-tôo.
Tse ê ì-sù sī án-ne ê sǹg-huat ê kiat-kó ē kah lí sóo siūnn ê bô-kâng:
Tī sò-ha̍k, tsāi-sǹg ē tī ka ê mà-tāi, in-uī án-ne kiat-kó ē sī \11\. Put-kò guá sī tsiàu thak-bûn ê sūn-sī lâi sǹg, kiat-kó sī \13\.

Bind.name: $~kiat-ha̍p
doc: $~Guá ti̍h *ta̍t* khioh miâ.
Tsiū-sī án-ni!
Guá ti̍h @FunctionDefinition kap @StructureDefinition ê @argument khioh miâ, mā ti̍h @Block lāi-té ê ta̍t khioh miâ. Guá ti̍h tsăng-tsāi khioh miâ!
O͘, lí ū-tsai-iánn tsit ê ta̍t ē-sái ū *tsin-tsē miâ* bô?
Guá cháinn kah beh kā lí kóng tsit-ê! Tsit ê @value, tsin-tsē ê @Names. Pí-lām:
Lí khuànn tio̍h guá tsò siánn-mih bô?
Tsit ê ta̍t, saⁿ ê miâ.
Lí ē-sái iōng hia *sûi* tsit ê miâ lâi tsí-tio̍h hit ê gō͘.
Lí beh iōng tsin-tsē @languages hōo miâ ê sî-chūn, tsit ê ē-tsin ū-iōng:

Án-ne kap án-ne ê tsò-hāng kāng-khuán:
\'niau-á'.ū('sió-sió')\
Tiòh, bô @FunctionDefinition guá sī sím-mih to bô. Guá tsí-ū hōo in ín-sòo, jiân-āu tuè in ê pōo-tsiú.
Sit-tsāi, guá iā ū guá ka-kī ê pún-tsāi. Pí-lūn, nā @FunctionDefinition ê tsi̍t-ê ín-sòo sī @Boolean, lí ē-tàng kā i ê miâ tok-ka siá-tshut-lâi kā i khui, m̄-tio̍h hōo i @value.

IncompatibleInput.resolutionDeclaration: $~Ài kā luī-hîng siá hō͘ tshing-tshó, in-uī $expected ài pó-liû ta̍t-ê guân-bīn ê ta̍t.
IncompatibleInput.resolutionWrap: $~Kā i pàng tī list, set á-sī map lāi-té, in-uī $expected ài chi̍t-tīn ta̍t.

UnknownTimeZone.explanation: $~Guá m̄-bat tsit-ê sî-khu *$zone*. Sî-khu ê miâ sī iōng tē-khu kap tsiânn-tshī tsò-miâ, ná-tshiūnn \'America/New_York'\. Lí tshiau-tshuē tsi̍t-ê lí bat ê tsiânn-tshī, guá tsiah lâi kā lí kiàn-gī!

FunctionDefinition.name: $~hâm-sik
doc: $~Guá siu tsi̍t-kuá su-ji̍p, jiân-āu iōng in lâi sǹg tsi̍t-ê @expression, sán-tshut tsi̍t-ê su-tshut. Koh-lâi gī lí-hó!
Tse sī tsi̍t-ê kán-tan ê lē:

\ƒ repeat(message•'') message × 5
repeat('hāi')\
Tsit-ê kong-lîng siu tsi̍t-ê su-ji̍p, \message\, iōng @Text.repeat kong-lîng lâi kā sùn-sit tāi-tāi ngóo-pái.
Lí nā beh tsiāu-tsiāu-tsāi ê koh sǹg tsi̍t-ê tāi-tsì, m̄-koh su-ji̍p bô-kâng, guá tsin ū-iōng!
Guá iáu ū hó-kuí-ê kî-thann ê sió-ki-kiāu. Pí-lūn kóng, guá m̄-bián ū miâ. Tsia, guá tsit-tsūn tsí-sī ti̍t-tsih khì @Evaluate tsò @value.
\(ƒ(message•'') message × 5)('hāi')\
Ia̍h-sī, tse sī tsi̍t-ê ē-sái siu kuí-ê su-ji̍p ê kong-lîng, tī su-ji̍p miâ ê āu-bīn iōng \…\ tsit-ê jī-guân.

\ƒ sī(messages…•'') messages.tûkhì('bô')
sī('sī' 'sī' 'bô' 'sī' 'bô')\
Lí khuànn-tio̍h in kā sìn-sit lóng 'no' thâi-tiāu bô? Tse sī in-uī messages sī @List, sóo-í lán ē-sái iōng @List.sansAll.
Tsi̍t-kuá sî-tsūn lí ē siūnn-beh kā guá sán-tshut ê ta̍t ê luī-hîng kóng hō-tshing-tshó. Tsiah tsò, tō tī su-ji̍p lia̍t-pió ê āu-bīn ke tsi̍t-ê @Is:
Lí khó-lêng ē khuànn-tio̍h tsit-ê ū būn-tê: i kóng i ê kiat-kó sī @Text, m̄-koh i siu nn̄g-ê @Number. Tsit-khài bô-tsi̍t-tsì ê sî, guá ē kā lí kóng!
Án-ni, bô @Evaluate ê sî-tsūn, guá tsin bô-ū-iōng; in tsiah ē hōo guá ū sìnn-miā.

Initial.name: $~khai-sí
doc: $~Guá kā lí kóng @Program tsit-kái ê khòaⁿ ê kiat-ko̍k sī-m̄-sī tē-it-kái, tsiū-sī @Boolean. Pí-lí kóng:
\◆ ? Sîkan() 'hāi'\
Lí khòaⁿ bô, m̄-koh tē-it-kái sī sî-kan, āu-piah ê sî-kan tshik-tshik tāu, guá lóng sī \⊥\, số-í @Conditional tsò-chhut \⊤\.
Nā-sī lí teh iōng @stream, koh kan-tann beh tī tē-it-kái tsò tāi-tsì, ia̍h-sī tī tē-it-kái ê sî m̄-thang tsò, guá tsiok pang-bán!

doc: $~Guá ē kā @Table ka-thiam sin ê tsi̍t-hâng. Lí ū khuànn-kuè tsi̍t-ê pió-keh kám-kak khah-bô-sián? Guá ē-sái kā thiam-tsīnn!
Sióng-khuànn lí ū tsi̍t-ê iû-hì ê ìn-iû-á pió-keh, lí beh thiam tsi̍t-ê sin-ê:

\players: ⎡miâ2•'' tuān•'' tiám2•#⎦
	⎡'jen' 'red' 1⎦
	⎡'joan' 'lâm' 0⎦
	⎡'jeff' 'red' 3⎦
	⎡'janet' 'lâm' 2⎦
players ⎡+'jason' 'red' 0⎦\

Tsiàⁿ-kì, kap Verse lāi-té ê sán-sán tāi-tsì kāng-khuán, guá bē kái pió-keh, guá tsí-sī kái-tsìn. Số-í lí tio̍h siūnn beh kā kái-tsìn ê pió-keh pàng tī toh. Siōng-ū-khó-lîng lí beh tī @Reaction kā pió-keh kái-tsìn kàu tsi̍t-ê ji̍p-tē, koh khǹg tī @Bind.

Insert.finish: $~Guá tsò-chhut tsi̍t-ê ū kái-tsìn ê hâng ê sin pió-keh!

Pí-lí kóng, ná-ū tsi̍t-ê sîn-bi̍t ê ta̍t. Guá ē kā lí kóng i sī-m̄-sī @Number, hō lí tsi̍t-ê @Boolean:

PatternLiteral.name: $~hōo-bóng
PatternLiteral.description: $~$#count[$count ê pō͘-hūn ê pattern|$count ê pō͘-hūn ê pattern]
doc: $~Guá sī tsi̍t-ê pattern! Guá miâ-siá ê sī bûn-jī ê *hîng-sīng*, m̄-sī tsîng-tsiânn ê jī, ïnn-uī án-ne lí ē-sái iōng \≈\ kiám-tsa ——tsióng-ê bûn-jī hap--bô?—— a̍h-sī iōng \⌕\ tshōe hit-ê hîng-sīng tī tá-lo̍h tshut-hiān. Tshōe--tshut-lâi ē hoê-tsiá tsi̍t-ê @Result ê list.
Tse sī tsi̍t-ê tshōe ê lē —— tī kóng tsá-tǹg ê kù-á tsiong tshōe tsiah-mi̍h-kiānn ê jī:

\breakfast: 'Guá tsá-tǹg tsia̍h ke-nn̄g, thò-sū, kah kam-á-tsap'
breakfast ⌕ ⣿ "eggs" | "toast" | "juice" | "pancakes"⣿\

Tòa tsò-pêng khuànn kàu tsiàⁿ-pêng. @PatternClass hap tsi̍t-ê tsióng-lūi ê jī-guân: \⣿◌⣿\ sī sím-mi̍h lóng hó, \⣿_⣿\ sī tsi̍t-ê jī-bó, \⣿#⣿\ sī tsi̍t-ê sò-jī, \⣿␣⣿\ sī tsi̍t-ê khang-keh. Ēng tshiùnn-tsì khǹg--ê ê bûn-jī sī @PatternLiteralText, ē tsiok-tsiânn hap, tshiūnn \⣿"-"⣿\. Sīnn-ê \⣿…⣿\ —— tsi̍t-ê @PatternRest —— ē hap jīm-hô sò-liōng ê jī-guân.

Sò-liōng sian lâi. @PatternQuantified ē kā āu-bīn hit-pō͘ tsiōng @PatternQuantifier tîng-hok: \⣿3 #⣿\ sī sann-ê sò-jī, \⣿3–5 #⣿\ sī sann kàu ngóo-ê, \⣿>0 #⣿\ sī tsi̍t-ê í-siōng, \⣿≥0 #⣿\ sī 0 ê í-siōng, \⣿≤1 #⣿\ sī ē-sái bô.
Iōng @PatternGroup pa̍k-hūn pō͘-hūn, iōng @PatternSequence thê-kiong sán-te̍k, tshiūnn \⣿(◌ | #)⣿\. Tsuàn-tsò-tī-tsi̍t-ê siōng tn̂g ê sán-te̍k thàn.

@PatternSet hap tsi̍t-ê tsi̍p-hap lāi-té ê tsi̍t-ê jī-guân, @PatternRange ē khuànn-tuè jī-guân ê @scope, tshiūnn \⣿ {"a"–"z" #}⣿\. Iōng @PatternComplement lâi hui-tīng tsi̍t-ê pō͘-hūn, tshiūnn \⣿~#⣿\.
Iōng @PatternProperty lâi sè-hūn tsi̍t-ê lūi-pia̍t, tshiūnn \⣿ _/greek⣿\ sī Hi-lia̍p jī-bó, a̍h-sī \⣿ ◌/emoji⣿\.
Iōng @PatternCapture kā tsi̍t-tsūn tsiok-tsiânn miâ-miâ, tshiūnn \⣿ year: (4 #)⣿\, ānn-āu iōng @PatternBackref tsi̍t-ê kan-tan ê miâ lâi tsài iōng. Muí-ê @Result ē iōng miâ pò-kò pa̍k-tio̍h ê tsūn.
Iōng @PatternAnchor tsuân-tsāi piⁿ-iân: \⣿⊢⣿\ khai-sí, \⣿⊣⣿\ kiat-sok. Iōng @PatternLook khuànn bô tsiah-ê: \⣿▸(#)⣿\ ia̍h-tsiân, \⣿◂(#)⣿\ ia̍h-āu.
Iōng @PatternWord \⣿ ▭/en⣿\ hap tsuân-ê tsi̍t-ê jī, a̍h-sī iōng @PatternWordEdge \⣿ ┊/en⣿\ hap jī ê piⁿ-kài, ūi @language lâi tsiat. Tī @PatternCaseFold \⣿ Aa("hi")⣿\ lāi-té bô-khuànn tuā-sè-siá.
Guá ê @type sī tsi̍t-ê @PatternType —— kā tsi̍t-ê miâ tsù-kái tsiah-ê, tshiūnn \p•⣿⣿: ⣿ ◌⣿\🪲 —— án-ne lí ē-sái kā guá khǹg tī tsi̍t-ê miâ, tī tsē-tsē bûn-jī tsiong-tsò tsài iōng.

doc: $~Guá sī tsi̍t-pâi pattern lōo-hūn, ùi tsó-pîng kàu iū-pîng, tsi̍t-ê tòe tsi̍t-ê lâi sio-hôo.
Ma-sī lán lâi khuànn tsi̍t-ê tiān-uē hō-bé ê hîng-á — sann-ê sò-jī, tsi̍t-tiâu tshuā-suànn, ê-hō̍ sì-ê:
Ná-sī hō guá kuí-ê soán-tik, guá tō ká-í tsit-ê ū-hap ê, khah-ài siōng tn̂g ê, kah \⣿ "cat" | "dog"⣿\ siâng-khuán.

OverlappingAlternatives.name: $~tiòng-tîng ê soán-tik
OverlappingAlternatives.explanation: $~$shorter sī $longer ê khai-thâu, koh-thài siōng tn̂g ê soán-tik tsóng-sī tshiânn-ing, số-í $shorter tsí ū tī $longer bô-hō sio-hôo ê sî-tsūn tsiah ē sio-hôo. Lí sī-m̄-sī ài án-ne?

PatternClass.name: $~jī-goân lūi-pia̍t
doc: $~Guá sio-hôo tsi̍t-lūi ê tsi̍t-ê jī-goân: \⣿◌⣿\ lām-ê grapheme, \⣿_⣿\ tsi̍t-ê jī-bó, \⣿#⣿\ tsi̍t-ê sò-jī, \⣿␣⣿\ tsi̍t-ê khang-keh.
Tshiūnn-ná, tùi tsi̍t-ê lia̍h-tsio̍h-ê tsi̍t-ê jī-bó tòe sò-jī @code khià tshut-lâi:

\codes: 'a1 b2 c3'
codes ⌕ ⣿ _ #⣿\
Lí ē-sái iōng quantifier ná \⣿>0 #⣿\ (tsi̍t-ê á-sī koh-khah-tsē ê sò-jī) lâi kè guá, á-sī iōng @property ná \⣿ _/greek⣿\ (Hi-lia̍p jī-bó) lâi siáu-iok guá.

PatternProperty.name: $~sio̍k-sìng
doc: $~Guá ē ka jī-goân lūi-pia̍t siáu-iok kàu tsi̍t-ê Unicode @property. Iōng tsi̍t-ê jī-thé, ná \⣿ _/greek⣿\, \⣿ _/han⣿\, á-sī \⣿ _/arabic⣿\.
Tshiūnn-ná, tī sio-tsham ê bûn-jī lāi-té tshiau-tshē Hi-lia̍p jī-bó ê tsi̍t-tsūn:

\text: 'hello αβγ world'
text ⌕ ⣿ >0 _/greek⣿\
Á-sī tsi̍t-ê lūi-pia̍t, ná \⣿ ◌/punctuation⣿\, \⣿ ◌/currency⣿\, \⣿ ◌/Nd⣿\ (tsi̍t-ê sò-jī), á-sī \⣿ _/Lu⣿\ (tsi̍t-ê tuā-sia jī-bó).
Á-sī sī-tsi̍t-ê sī-á-m̄-sī ê sio̍k-sìng, ná \⣿ ◌/emoji⣿\ á-sī \⣿ _/uppercase⣿\ — lí iā ē-sái siá-tshut miâ kah @value, ná \⣿ ◌/Script=Greek⣿\.
Iōng @PatternComplement lâi pâi-tû tsi̍t-ê sio̍k-sìng, ná \⣿ ~◌/emoji⣿\ (m̄-sī emoji ê lóng ū).

UnrecognizedPatternProperty.name: $~bô-tsai-iánn ê sio̍k-sìng
UnrecognizedPatternProperty.explanation: $~Guá bô-jīn-bat sio̍k-sìng $name. Lí tshìn-tshái tsi̍t-ê lūi-pia̍t, jī-thé, á-sī Unicode id.

PatternQuantifier.name: $~quantifier
doc: $~Guá kóng aū sio-hôo kuí-kái: tsi̍t-ê tik-tik ê \⣿3 #⣿\, tsi̍t-ê @scope \⣿3–5 #⣿\, \⣿=3 #⣿\ (tik-tik sann-kái), \⣿>0 #⣿\ (tsi̍t-kái á-sī koh-khah-tsē), \⣿≥0 #⣿\ (khòng-kái á-sī koh-khah-tsē), \⣿<5 #⣿\ (tsió-kî gōo-kái), \⣿≤1 #⣿\ (ē-sái ū ē-sái bô).
Tshiūnn-ná, tshiau-tshē tsi̍t-kù uē-lāi ê múi-tsi̍t-tsūn sò-jī:

\text: 'Guá ū 3 tsiah niau kah 12 tsiah hî'
text ⌕ ⣿ >0 #⣿\
Guá tsiàu-sī tī guá beh kè ê lōo-hūn ê thâu-chêng, ná \⣿3 #⣿\ á-sī \⣿>0 _⣿\.

MalformedQuantifier.name: $~bô khó-lêng ê kái-sò
MalformedQuantifier.explanation: $~Guá ê tsió-sò khah tuā kuè guá ê tuā-sò, số-í guá lóng bē-sio-hôo-tit.
MalformedQuantifier.resolution: $~Ka guá ê kái-sò tuì-tāu, hō khah-sè ê tī thâu-chêng

PatternQuantified.name: $~tiōng-hok
doc: $~Guá ē tuì-tio̍h āu-tsūn ê pōo-hūn tsit-kuá pái.
Pí-lih kóng, kiám-tsa ZIP @code sī-m̄-sī tsiok-tsāi 5 ê sò-jī:

Guá thang sǹg 1 lūi, pí-lih \⣿3 #⣿\ (3 ê sò-jī), 1 tīng, pí-lih \⣿ 2 ("ab")⣿\ (2 ê "ab"), iā-sī 1 ê hóo-tsī-ê, pí-lih \⣿2 ~#⣿\ (2 ê m̄-sī sò-jī). Ti-ê \⣿>0 #⣿\, guá tsiok tham — guá ē ná-tsiah-tsiok-ê ná-tsiah-tsiok-ê.

PatternCapture.name: $~tiāⁿ-tio̍h
doc: $~Guá ê miâ kàu 1 ê tuì-tio̍h ê pōo-hūn, hōo lí thang tuì tsit-ê @Result ê mi̍h tshiūⁿ-khuànn.
Pí-lih kóng, tuì 1 ê ji̍t-kî ê nî, gue̍h, ji̍t tshuā-tshut-lâi:
Sòo-ê āu-bīn ê @how, koh siá guá ê miâ tō ē-tàng iōng — khuànn @PatternBackref — pí-lih \⣿ w: (>0 _) ␣ w⣿\ lâi tshē tiōng-hok ê jī.

DuplicateCaptureName.name: $~tiōng-hok ê tiāⁿ-tio̍h
DuplicateCaptureName.explanation: $~Lēng-gua 1 ê tiāⁿ-tio̍h í-king iōng $name tsit-ê miâ, só-í tsit-ê ē khàm-tiāu i.

PatternComplement.name: $~m̄-sī
doc: $~Guá tuì-tio̍h 1 ê ji̍t-tsú-ê, m̄-sī āu-bīn ê hit-ê. Thang hóo-tsī 1 ê lūi, pí-lih \⣿~#⣿\ (m̄-sī sò-jī), iā-sī 1 ê tsi̍p-ha̍p, pí-lih \⣿~{":" ␣}⣿\ (m̄-sī mn̄g-tiám iā-sī khang-kheh).
Pí-lih kóng, kā mn̄g-tiám ê @key kap @value tshuā-tshut-lâi, tuì-tio̍h m̄-sī mn̄g-tiám iā-sī khang-kheh ê 1 tsūn:

\tuì: 'tshiūnn-sik: lâm'
tuì ⌕ ⣿ >0 ~{":" ␣}⣿\
Iā thang hóo-tsī 1 ê tsōo, pí-lih \⣿~(◌ | #)⣿\, iā-sī 1 ê @property pí-lih \⣿ ~◌/emoji⣿\ (m̄-sī emoji).
Phāng guá tī @PatternLook ê tsiàn-bīn lâi hóo-tsī i: \⣿~▸(#)⣿\ ê ì-sù sī "āu-bīn m̄-sī sò-jī", \⣿~◂("$")⣿\ ê ì-sù sī "tsiàn-bīn m̄-sī kim-kuân-hû".

PatternGroup.name: $~tsōo
doc: $~Guá kā tsiok-tsiok pōo-hūn pau-tsò-hóo, hōo 1 ê sò-bo̍k iā-sī 1 ê kéng-tsik thang kàu in uân-pōo. Guá bē tiāⁿ-tio̍h; beh kiò-miâ tō iōng @PatternCapture.
Pí-lih kóng, kiám-tsa 1 kóa jī-bûn sī-m̄-sī "ab" tsit-ê im-tsiat tiōng-hok:

\chant: 'ababab'
chant ≈ ⣿ >0 ("ab")⣿\
Sǹg 1 ê tsōo, pí-lih \⣿ 2 ("ab")⣿\ (2 ê "ab"), iā-sī 1 ê kéng-tsik, pí-lih \⣿(◌ | #)⣿\ (1 ê jī-bó iā-sī 1 ê sò-jī).

PatternSet.name: $~jī-hing tsi̍p-ha̍p
doc: $~Guá tuì-tio̍h 1 ê tsi̍p-ha̍p lāi-té ê ta̍k-ê grapheme.
Pí-lih kóng, tshē 1 ê jī ê bó-im:
Kā @scope kap lūi ha̍p-tsò-hóo, pí-lih \⣿ {"a"–"z" #}⣿\ iā-sī \⣿ {# "a"–"f"}⣿\ (1 ê tsa̍p-lio̍k-ûn sò-jī). Iōng @PatternComplement lâi hóo-tsī, pí-lih \⣿~{"!" "?"}⣿\.

PatternRange.name: $~huān-uî
doc: $~Guá tuì-tio̍h 2 ê tsit-tsūn tsiong-kan, uī-tsū kâng-tsūn sūn-sī lāi-té ê grapheme, guá tiàm @PatternSet lāi-té.
Pí-lih kóng, tuì 1 kóa jī-bûn tshuā-tshut sió-siá jī-bó ê jī:

\text: 'hello world 2026'
text ⌕ ⣿ >0 {"a"–"z"}⣿\
Kā jī-bó, pí-lih \⣿ {"a"–"z" "A"–"Z"}⣿\, iā-sī sò-jī, pí-lih \⣿{"0"–"9"}⣿\, tuì sím-mih bûn-jī lóng ē-tàng, pí-lih \⣿ {"あ"–"ん"}⣿\.

PatternLiteralText.name: $~lí-sik
doc: $~Guá kap kue-hioh-ē ê bûn-jī tsiânn-tsiânn kâng, bô lia̍h-tshut kî-thiann ê ì-sù.
Mā-sī kóng, tī tsi̍t-kù uē lāi-té tshuē tshut kim-ia̍h:

\receipt: 'Kin-á-ji̍t tse tio̍h $5'
receipt ⌕ ⣿ "$" >0 #⣿\
Lí thang iōng guá lâi phah koo-tīng ê pōo-hūn, pí-lūn \⣿"-"⣿\, \⣿"@"⣿\, kàu-sī sì-kì ê tsi̍t-ê jī \⣿ "cat"⣿\, kap kî-thann pōo-hūn liâm-teh, pí-lūn \⣿3 # "-" 4 #⣿\ tsuè tiān-uē hō-bé.

PatternAnchor.name: $~tīng-tiám
doc: $~Guá kap bûn-jī ê piⁿ tui-tioh, m̄ tah-tsuè tio̍h-ê kî-thann: \⣿⊢⣿\ sī khai-thâu, \⣿⊣⣿\ sī kiat-bué.
Mā-sī kóng, kiám-tsa tsi̍t-kù pìn-hōo-uē sī-m̄-sī í "Hello" khai-thâu:

\greeting: 'Sè-kài, lí-hó'
greeting ≈ ⣿ ⊢ "Hello" …⣿\
Ke-tshiu uī-tì, pí-lūn \⣿ ⊢ "Hi"⣿\ (í "Hi" khai-thâu), \⣿"." ⊣⣿\ (í ku-tiám kiat-bué), kàu-sī \⣿⊢ _ ⊣⣿\ (tsiah-ê bûn-jī tsí-ū tsi̍t-ê jī).

PatternWord.name: $~sû
doc: $~Guá kap tsi̍t-ê uān-tsíng ê jī tui-tioh, iōng @language ka-tī ê kui-tsik lâi tshuē.
Mā-sī kóng, lia̍t-tshut tsi̍t-kù uē lāi-té ê jī:

\sentence: 'niau tsē leh'
sentence ⌕ ⣿ ▭/en⣿\
Kóng-tshut gí-giân, pí-lūn \⣿ ▭/en⣿\ sī Eng-gí, \⣿ ▭/zh⣿\ sī Tiong-bûn, koh iōng piⁿ lâi kai-tīng tsi̍t-ê jī, pí-lūn \⣿ ┊/en "cat" ┊/en⣿\.

MissingPatternLocale.name: $~khuí gí-giân
MissingPatternLocale.explanation: $~Guá su-iàu tsi̍t-ê gí-giân tsiah tsai-iánn án-tsuánn tshuē jī. Lí thang kha-ke tsi̍t-ê, pí-lūn \/en\ buē?

PatternWordEdge.name: $~jī ê piⁿ
doc: $~Guá kap @language ê jī kài-sòaⁿ tui-tioh, m̄ tah-tsuè tio̍h-ê kî-thann.
Mā-sī kóng, tshuē "cat" tsit-ê uān-tsíng ê jī, m̄-sī tī "category" lāi-té:

\text: 'tsi̍t tsiah niau tī tsi̍t ê lūi-pia̍t'
text ⌕ ⣿ ┊/en "cat" ┊/en⣿\
Kā tsi̍t-ê jī lī-tsāi ê lāng-á, pí-lūn \⣿ ┊/en "cat" ┊/en⣿\, tsiah-ē tsí kap uān-tsíng ê jī tui-tioh.

PatternLook.name: $~khuànn-tsiânn-uî
doc: $~Guá khuànn tsîng-bīn \⣿▸(#)⣿\ iah-sī āu-bīn \⣿◂(#)⣿\ ê tsit-ê, m̄ tah-tsuè tio̍h-ê, só-í ē-té ê pōo-hūn iû-guân ē tùi-tsi̍t-ê uī-tì khai-sí tui-tioh.
Mā-sī kóng, tshuē múi-ê āu-bīn kīnn-tio̍h su-jī ê jī-bú:

\text: 'a1 b2 cc'
text ⌕ ⣿ _ ▸(#)⣿\
Í-iāu-kiû tsiânn-tsiānn ê sîng-hōo, pí-lūn \⣿_ ▸(#)⣿\ (jī-bú āu-bīn kīnn-tio̍h su-jī) iah-sī \⣿◂("$") >0 #⣿\ ("$" āu-bīn ê su-jī).
Iōng @PatternComplement lâi hoán-kuè-lâi, put-tsun-iōng sîng-hōo, pí-lūn \⣿~▸(#)⣿\ (āu-bīn bô kīnn-tio̍h su-jī).

PatternBackref.name: $~hôe-tsí
doc: $~Guá kap @PatternCapture í-king tui-tioh ê bûn-jī kâng-khuán — tsí-ài siá tsit-ê pua̍t-miâ ê pún-miâ.
Mā-sī kóng, tshuē tsi̍t-ê liân-sòa tsîng-hok ê jī:

\text: 'niau niau tsē tsē leh'
text ⌕ ⣿ w: (>0 _) ␣ w⣿\
Nā-sī tsi̍t-ê m̄-sī pua̍t-miâ ê pún-miâ, tō ē-sī tsi̍t-ê ū-miâ ê lūi-pia̍t, pí-lūn \⣿ linebreak⣿\.

UndefinedBackreference.name: $~bô-tsai ê miâ
UndefinedBackreference.explanation: $~Bô miâ-tsò $name ê pua̍t-miâ iah-sī lūi-pia̍t, guá bô-ta̍t thang tui.

PatternRest.name: $~sió-khuá
doc: $~Guá kap tshun-lo̍h-lâi ê bûn-jī tui-tioh, ē-sái tsiok-tsē. Tī tsi̍t-ê pōo-hūn ê bué-tsîng, guá tsiok-hó iōng.
Mā-sī kóng, kiám-tsa tsi̍t-kù uē sī-m̄-sī hashtag — "#" āu-bīn ê sím-mih lóng ē-sái:

\tag: '#tsá-tǹg'
tag ≈ ⣿ "#" …⣿\
Tī koo-tīng ê khai-thâu āu-bīn iōng guá, pí-lūn \⣿"#" …⣿\ ("#" āu-bīn ê sím-mih lóng ē-sái) iah-sī \⣿ "Hi " …⣿\ ("Hi " āu-bīn ê lóng-sī).

PatternCaseFold.name: $~put-tsuè tuā-sè-jī
doc: $~Guá tui-tioh ê pōo-hūn bô-tsuè tuā-jī sió-jī.
Mā-sī kóng, kiám-tsa tsi̍t-ê jī, put-tsuè ka-tī tuā-jī iah-sī sió-jī:

\huah: 'LÍ-HÓ'
huah ≈ ⣿ Aa("hello")⣿\

Kā guá ê pōo-hūn kheh-tī, pí-lūn \⣿ Aa("hi")⣿\ (ē kap "HI", "Hi", iah-sī "hi" tui-tioh). Ka-tī tsi̍t-ê @language lâi iōng i ê kui-tsik, pí-lūn \⣿ Aa/tr("i")⣿\ (Turkic ê i), guá mā @scope tsi̍t-ê @PatternBackref, pí-lūn \⣿ Aa(w: (2 _) w)⣿\.

PatternType.name: $~pōo-hūn ê luī-hîng
doc: $~Guá sī tsit-ê @type ê tôo-iūnn @value, tsù-kái ê khuán-sik sa̍h \p•⣿⣿: ⣿ ◌⣿\🪲.
Mé-kuá, lí thang kā tsit-ê tôo-iūnn khǹg tī @name, jiân-āu tī chiâu-chē bûn-jī lāi-té tsài-sú-iōng:

\digits: ⣿ >0 #⣿
'Guá ū 3 tsiah niau kah 12 tsiah hî' ⌕ digits\
Khǹg-hó liáu-āu, tī tsū-tsiah tôo-iūnn ē-sái ê tē-hng lóng thang iōng guá, ná-tshái \text ⌕ digits\🪲 á-sī \text ≈ digits\🪲.

MapLiteral.name: $~Map jī-bīn-ta̍t
MapLiteral.doc: $~Guá sī kiān kap @values tsiong-kan ê tsi̍t-ê @Map. Khuànn @Map, tsae-iáu guá án-tsuánn ū-iōng.

Match.name: $~phāinn-tuì
Match.description: $~Kā $value kap $#count[$count ê ke-sū|$count ê ke-sū] phāinn-tuì
doc: $~Guá sī @condition kiám-tsa lāi-té siōng bē-sai ê: guá ná @value, kap kuí-nā-ê ke-sū pí-kàu, jiân-āu sǹg tsiah-ê phāinn-tuì ê!
Mé-kuá, ná-sī lí ū @Number, siūnn-beh kā i piàn-tsò @Text, ē-sái án-ne tsò:

\number: 2
number ???
	1: 'tsi̍t'
	2: 'nn̄g'
	3: 'sann'
	'koh khah tuā!'\
Ná-sī lóng bô phāinn-tuì, guá tō sǹg lí hōo guá ê siūnn-tshái @expression.
Guá tuì-kā tsòng-tsiàu in-uī ū-bē-tsió ê @Number, @Text, á-sī khah ho̍k-tsa ê ta̍t, piàn-tsò pat-ê tāi-tsì, tsin ū-iōng.
Lí mā ē-sái iōng tī @Boolean á-sī @None, m̄-kú in bē ū hiah-nī-tsē khuán, só-í tuì hiah-ê kán-tan ê ta̍t, guá bô-án-tsuánn ū-iōng.

Kap @Conditional kāng-khuán, guá mā ē kā lí kóng guá ha̍k-tio̍h siánn. Tī tsi̍t-ê ke-sū lāi-té, guá phāinn-tuì ê @value tsai-iánn tō-sī hit-ê ke-sū; tī āu-bīn ê ke-sū, i tsai-iánn bô-sī tsìn-tsîng ê lóng-tsóng tsi̍t-ê; tī guá ê siūnn-tshái, i tsai-iánn kui-ê lóng m̄-sī.

\answer•#|'': 1
answer ???
	1: answer + 1
	'm̄-sī tsi̍t'\

Guá thang pâi-tû @Number, @None, á-sī @Text tshiū tsi̍t-ê tsuan-huànn ê ke-sū, kap pat-khuán kán-tan ê ke-sū. M̄-kú tsi̍t-ê ke-sū nā-sī sǹg tsi̍t-ê tāi-tsì, tō bô pâi-tû siánn-mih, só-í guá ê siūnn-tshái lóng tshun-lâi @value iáu ū khó-lîng sī ê lóng-tsóng.

NumberLiteral.name: $~Sò-jī jī-bīn-ta̍t
NumberLiteral.doc: $~Guá sī tsi̍t-ê @Number. Lí ē-sái iōng @language ê ta̍k-khuán sò-jī lâi siá guá. Khuànn @Number, tsai-iáu guá ē-sái tsò siánn.

NotANumber.name: $~bô-sī sò-jī
NotANumber.explanation: $~Guá siūnn guá tsai-iánn ta̍k-ê sò-jī, m̄-kú tsit-ê guá m̄ tsai

InternalExpression.name: $~lāi-pōo piáu-ta̍t-sik
InternalExpression.doc: $~Guá sī tsi̍t-ê tsí-iōng guân-pún tsok-tsia ê @expression. Lí án-tsuánn tshuē-tio̍h guá? Siūnn-beh khah tsē liáu-kái guá, lí tio̍h kap in kóng.

NoneLiteral.name: $~bô ê bûn-jī-ta̍t
NoneLiteral.doc: $~Guá tsò @None, tsit-ê khá-it-bô-jī ê bô-mā @value. Khuànn @None lâi liáu-kái khah-tsē.

Otherwise.name: $~bô--ê-ūi
doc: $~Guá kiám-tsa @value sī-m̄-sī @None, nā sī, guá tō tsóng lí tsi̍t-ê pī-iōng ê ta̍t.
/Pí-lih kóng, nā lí ū tsi̍t-ê ta̍t khó-lîng sī @Number iáu-sī @None, @Otherwise ē pang-tsān lí hōo tsi̍t-ê ân-sin ê sò-jī:

\maybeNumber•#|ø: 1
maybeNumber ?? 0\

Previous.name: $~siōng-tsîng
doc: $~Guá ē tńg-thâu khuànn @stream ê le̍k-sú, kā lí kóng i kuè-khì ê tsi̍t-ê @values. Lí ū siūnn-kuè beh kì-tit kuè-khì ê tāi-tsì bô?
Guá sī Verse ê kuan-hong kì-lio̍k-guân!
Pí-lih kóng, @Time ngóo tsiūnn-tī nn̄g-tsiap-á tsîng sī án-ne:
\← 5 Sîkan(1000ms)\
Khuànn i ū-khah-bô @None 5 miáu, ê āu-lâi tsuah-jiân sī tsi̍t-ê siōng-tsîng ê sî-kan?
Nā-sī lí beh siōng-kîn ê kuí-ê ta̍t, hōo guá nn̄g-ê ȷiòng-thâu, guá ē kā sò-jī tòng-tsò ê sò-liōng:
Khuànn i sī siōng-tsîng ê gōo-pái sî-kan, m̄-sī tsi̍t-pái nā-tiāu-á?
Lí beh tsò ê piáu-iân ài ēng-tio̍h kuè-khì ê sî, guá tō ū-ēng.

Program.name: $~tshing-sik
doc: $~Guá sī piáu-iân khai-sí kap kiat-sok ê tē-tī, pau-hâm kî-thaⁿ ê kak-sik, kā tsit-tsháng piáu-iân tsò khí-lâi.
Lí tsai-iánn @Block ē sǹg tsi̍t-tsūn piáu-ta̍t-sik, siōng-āu-ê tsiū-sī i ê kiat-kó--m?

This.name: $~tsit-ê
doc: $~Guá sī \⬚\, tsi̍t-ê sè-sè-á ê tsìng-hîng, tāi-piáu @code tng teh tsò ê @value, lí bē-su-iàu kā guá khí-miâ.
Tī @ConversionDefinition lāi-té, guá sī tsiânn-teh pìnn ê ta̍t:

\→ #rainbows #joys ⬚ × 1000000joys
2rainbows → #joys\
Tī @Reaction lāi-té, guá sī tsòe-kīn ê ta̍t:
Tī @Translate lāi-té, guá sī tsiânn-teh tuì-ing ê hit-ê hāng-ba̍k, tsiū-sī tse ē kā múi-ê ta̍t ke tsi̍t:
Iā tī @StructureDefinition lāi-té, guá sī tsit-sî ê ta̍t pún-sin, sóo-í guá ē-sái iōng \⬚.rank\🪲 khì kàu guá ka-tī ê pō-hūn, tō-pí-lí iōng \other.rank\🪲 khì kàu pa̍t-ê ta̍t ê pō-hūn:

\•phái(rank•#) (
	ƒ beats(other•phái) ⬚.rank > other.rank
)

phái(10).beats(phái(7))\
Guá bô tsiok-tsi̍t tshut-hiān, m̄-koh tshut-hiān ê sî, ē-sái tsin-tsiàⁿ pang-tsō tsi̍t-ê ta̍t lī-khui @Bind!

MisplacedThis.name: $~tsit ê tsù-tsiàu khǹg tshò uī-tì
MisplacedThis.explanation: $~Guá tsí-ū ē-sái tī kiat-kò, tsuán-huān, huán-ìng, a̍h-sī huan-ik lāi-té.

UnaryEvaluate.name: $~tuann-ûn-sǹg-hû kè-sǹg
doc: $~Guá ē kè-sǹg tsi̍t ê @FunctionDefinition, i tsí tshiú tsi̍t ê @value, i ê it-ê-hû-hō miâ siá tī su-ji̍p ê thâu-tsîng — pí-lūn \-x\🪲 a̍h-sī \~b\🪲. Lí bat tsai-iánn lí ē-sái án-ne siá bô?
An-ne:
A̍h-sī án-ne:
Tsiah-ê pí \(1 + 1).negate()\🪲 a̍h-sī \⊥.m̄sī()\ khah-iông-ì khuànn, mài-sī?
Lí bián án-ne siá guá, m̄-koh khó-lîng ē khah-pán-piān.
Tsí-ū tsi̍t ê kui-tik: miâ kap ta̍t tiong-kan bē-sái ū khòng-keh. Nā-bô lí khó-lîng tī-teh tsò @Reference a̍h-sī @BinaryEvaluate.

UnparsableExpression.name: $~bē-tàng hun-sik
doc: $~Guá sī tsi̍t tsām @code, bô-tō-lí, in-uī án-ne bô lâng tsai-iánn guá sī sím-mih ì-sù.
jkwel fjiwojvioao jjiweo jrfe
/Bô-sī múi ê @expression tī bú-tâi-téng lóng ū ì-sù./
s w ieorjwei iojwi jfkdlsfdsk
/Sit-tsāi, lí ē-sái kóng ê uē, ū siuⁿ-tsiâⁿ bô-tō-lí ê./
dsk sdlk jdkfiewipapweiurb,v kdsfdsf
/Lí án-ne siá ê sî, guá tō tshut-hiān, in-uī guá m̄-tsai lí sī beh kóng sím-mih./
Lí sī tó-iân, só-í tsí-ū lí tsiah tsai-iánn lí khó-lîng sī beh kóng sím-mih!

conflict.name: $~khuànn-bô ê code
conflict.explanation: $~@FunctionDefinition tī tsia, @UnparsableExpression m̄-tsai tsit ê $expression[ piáu-ta̍t-sik | luī-hîng ] sī siánn-mih luī-hîng.

UnparsableException.explanation: $~Lín-hó, guá sī @FunctionDefinition! Guán m̄-tsai tsit ê tsí-lēng sī sím-mih ì-sù, só-í teh-tsū.

Update.name: $~keng-sin
doc: $~Guá pang-bāng siu-kái tsi̍t ê @Table, tshuē-tshut tùi-tio̍h tsi̍t ê @condition ê hâng, jiân-āu tsò-tshut ū sin @values ê siu-kái-kuè ê hâng.
Pí-lūn, nā-sī lí ū tsi̍t tiuⁿ kak-sik kap hun-sòo ê piáu, lí beh hō tsi̍t tūi lāi-té múi ê kak-sik tsi̍t hun, lí ē-sái án-ne:

\players: ⎡name•'' team•'' points•#⎦
⎡'jen' 'red' 1⎦
⎡'joan' 'blue' 0⎦
⎡'jeff' 'red' 3⎦
⎡'janet' 'blue' 2⎦
players ⎡: points: points + 1 ⎦ team = 'blue'\
Lí ē-sái iōng @Bind kóng beh kái tó-ê lân-uī, mā ē-sái tī tiâu-kiānn lāi-té iōng @scope ê lân-uī miâ a̍h-sī kî-thâ miâ.
Update.finish: $~Kè-sǹg ê kiat-kó sī tsi̍t tiuⁿ ū siu-kái-kuè ê hâng ê sin piáu!

ExpectedColumnBind.name: $~khuí lân-uī ê ta̍t
ExpectedColumnBind.explanation: $~Guá siong-iàu múi-tsı̍t lân-uī lóng ài ū ta̍t
ExpectedColumnBind.resolution: $~Kā tsit keh-á pau tsò ū miâ ê lân-uī

IncompatibleCellType.name: $~keh-á ê luī-hîng bô sio-tâng
IncompatibleCellType.explanation: $~Guá ài sī luī-hîng $expected, m̄-koh guá sī $given
IncompatibleCellType.resolutionLiteral: $~Iōng ! kā tsit ê list, set á-sī map piau-kì tsò literal, ta̍t tsiū ē pó-tshî tsi̍t-tīng, m̄-tsiū-sī pian-tsò tsiàu-kuat — $expected ài ê sī tsi̍t-tīng ê ta̍t
IncompatibleCellType.resolutionOtherwise: $~Iōng ?? lâi tshú-lí khuí-sit ê ta̍t, in-uī $expected m̄ ún-hú ø
IncompatibleCellType.resolutionGuard: $~Seng iōng luī-hîng siu-huē khuànn i sī m̄-sī $expected, in-uī $expected bē-sái sī pat-ê khó-lîng ê luī-hîng
IncompatibleCellType.resolutionDeclaration: $~Ài kā luī-hîng siá hō͘ tshing-tshó, in-uī $expected ài pó-liû ta̍t-ê guân-bīn ê ta̍t.
IncompatibleCellType.resolutionWrap: $~Kā i pàng tī list, set á-sī map lāi-té, in-uī $expected ài chi̍t-tīn ta̍t.
IncompatibleCellType.resolutionStructure: $~Kā i pau tī $expected lāi-té, in-uī che ê khang-uī ài $expected ta̍t.
IncompatibleCellType.resolutionDefault: $~Hō͘ tsit-ê binding chi̍t-ê khai-sí ê ta̍t, in-uī $expected tsia bē-sái thiàu-kuè.
IncompatibleCellType.resolutionWiden: $~Hō͘ tsit-ê binding ê ta̍t ê luī-hîng khuah-sut-leh, in-uī $expected thài sió, bē-tòng-tit kî-sit tshun-leh ê mih.
IncompatibleCellType.resolutionReorder: $~Kā ín-sòo ê sūn-sī hōo-sio-huānn, in-uī in ê luī-hîng án-ne khah tsiâu-tâng — $expected tio̍h-ài tī tsi̍t-ê khang-uī.
IncompatibleCellType.resolutionPlaceholder: $~Seng ēng khang-uī thè-tāi, in-uī $expected ài ê — liáu-āu tuì autocomplete ê tsu-tuann kéng chi̍t-ê ta̍t.

AnyType.name: $~sím-mih lóng ū thang
AnyType.doc: $~Guá tāi-piáu tout-hōe @type. Ū-sî guá tshut-hiān, sī in-uī guá m̄ tsai @value sī sím-mih luī-hîng, số-í tshái-tshái lóng ū khó-lîng.

BooleanType.name: $~boolean luī-hîng
doc: $~Guá kap @Bind tàu-tīn, suat-bîng tsı̍t-ê miâ sī @Boolean @value. Án-ne:
\hungry•?: 'jello'\🪲
Ná-sī lí siūnn beh khak-tīng sió-mih sī @Boolean, iōng guá, guá tō kā lí kiám-tsa!

ConversionType.name: $~conversion luī-hîng
doc: $~Guá kap @Bind tàu-tīn, piáu-sī tsı̍t-ê miâ sī @ConversionDefinition. Lí khó-lîng bô-tsiáu-ài iōng guá, in-uī bô guā-tsē lâng kā guá ták-lâng tsò @value lâi thoân, m̄-koh nā ū, guá ê khuànn-sik tō án-ne:

FormattedType.name: $~ū-kué-sik bûn-jī luī-hîng
doc: $~Guá kap @Bind tàu-tīn, kì-lio̍k tsı̍t-ê miâ sī @FormattedLiteral @value. Án-ne:
\hungry•`…`: `Guá tsiok phiau-liāng ê!`\🪲
Siūnn beh khak-tīng sió-mih sī @FormattedLiteral ta̍t? Án-ne tō tit-tio̍h khak-tīng.

ExceptionType.name: $~lī-guā
ExceptionType.doc: $~Guá tāi-piáu tsı̍t-ê lī-guā. Bô-hoat-tōo kā bind kóng guá sī lī-guā, in-uī lī-guā tsí ē kā @Program thîng-tsí, số-í lí bē-sái kā in tsò @values iōng.

FunctionType.name: $~function luī-hîng
doc: $~Guá tāi-piáu tsı̍t-ê @FunctionDefinition. Nā-sī lí siūnn beh kóng @Bind lāi-té khǹg ê sī sím-mih function, guá tsin ū-iōng! Án-ne:
\math•ƒ(a2•# b2•# c2•# d•#) #: ƒ interesting(a3•# b3•# c3•# d2•#) a3 + b3 + c3 + d2\🪲

ListType.name: $~list luī-hîng
doc: $~Guá tsin /kah-ì/ @List. Guá thang kā @Bind kóng in sī sím-mih list! Án-ne, guá kóng tse sī @Number ê list:
Guá ū saⁿ-khuán kóng-hoat. Nā-sī guá lóng bô kóng luī-hîng, list ê tn̂g-té bô-hān-tsè, mā thang khǹg sím-mih lóng ū:
\stuff•[]: [1 'nn̄g' ø]\🪲
Nā-sī guá kóng tsı̍t-khuán luī-hîng, list ê tn̂g-té iû-guân bô-hān-tsè, m̄-koh lāi-té ê mih lóng ài sī hit-khuán luī-hîng, tō-sī téng-bīn hit-ê @Number ê list.
Nā-sī guá kóng kuí-khuán luī-hîng, guá ê ì-sì tō-sī chiok-chāi hit-kuá-ê mih ê list, múi-ê uī-tī lóng ū tsı̍t-khuán luī-hîng. Tsit-ê sī nn̄g-ê mih ê list: thâu-tsiūnn sī @Number, āu-pêng sī @Text.

Tsòng-āu hit-ê guá siōng kah-ì, in-uī án-ne ták-ê lâng lóng tsai sím-mih tī tá-lìn. @ListAccess tsai thâu-tsiūnn sī @Number, tē-jī-ê sī @Text; nā-sī lí hō guá ê mih ê sò-liōng m̄-tio̍h, á-sī sūn-sī pàng m̄-tio̍h, guá ē kā lí kóng!

MapType.name: $~map
MapType.description: $~map luī-hîng, $key[$key|sím-mih lóng ū thang] tùi $value[$value|sím-mih lóng ū thang]
doc: $~Guá kā @Bind kóng tsı̍t-ê miâ khǹg ê sī sím-mih @Map — in ê kiān kap @values sī sím-mih luī-hîng. Lí tsai @Map guā-nī tsiok-hó? Sī tsin-tsiàⁿ tsiok-hó. Tsia ū tsı̍t-ê sò-jī tùi list ê map:

NumberType.name: $~sò·-jī
doc: $~Guá kā @Bind kóng tsı̍t-ê miâ khǹg ê sī @Number. Lí tsai @Bind ài sī sím-mih? Sī @Number — in-uī sò-jī siōng hó!

RangeType.name: $~huān-uî
doc: $~Guá kā @Bind kóng, tsit-ê miâ ê @value sī @Range — nn̄g-ê @Number kài-hān, kap tsāi in tiong-kan ê múi-ê sòo-jī.

NameType.name: $~kiat-kò
doc: $~Guá ēng miâ lâi tāi-piáu @StructureDefinition. Pí-lūn kóng, nā-sī lí ū tsit-khuán kiat-kò͘, lí tō ē-sái tsò tsi̍t-ê @Bind lâi khǹg i sán-sing ê @values.

\•Friend(miâ2•'')
bestie•Friend: Friend('Jonah')\🪲

UnknownTypeName.name: $~bô-tsai-iánn ê luī-hîng miâ
UnknownTypeName.explanation: $~Luī-hîng miâ tsí ē-sái tsí kiat-kò͘ ia̍h-sī luī-hîng piàn-sòo, m̄-koh tsit-ê tsí-kàu ê sī luī-hîng $type

NeverType.name: $~bô-khó-lêng
NeverType.doc: $~Guá tāi-piáu tsi̍t-ê bô-khó-lêng ê @type. Pí-lūn lí mn̄g @Is tsit-ê @value sī-m̄-sī @Number, m̄-koh i tsiânn-tsiânn bē-sái sī sòo-jī.

NoneType.name: $~bô luī-hîng
doc: $~@None sī tsòng-tsòng bô ê tsòng-tsòng, guá tō sī in ê tiōng-sīn tāi-piáu.
\space•ø: ø\🪲

SetType.name: $~tsi̍p-ha̍p luī-hîng
doc: $~Guá kā @Bind kóng, tsit-ê miâ ê @value sī mi̍h-kiānn luī-hîng ê @Set. @Set sī tsòe hó ê, sī tsin-tsiànn ê!
\unique•{''}: {'ta̍k-mi̍h' 'sím-mi lóng ē-sái' 'ta̍k-lâng'}\🪲

StreamDefinitionType.name: $~tsu-liāu-liû tīng-gī luī-hîng
StreamDefinitionType.doc: $~Guá tāi-piáu lí tīng-gī ê @stream, tse sī bē-sái ê, án-ne lí uī-sím-mi̍h iáu teh khuànn tsit-tuānn?

StreamType.name: $~tsu-liāu-liû luī-hîng
doc: $~Guá kóng-kì @streams ê súi kap ì-sù… hōo @Bind lâi khǹg in:
\time•…#ms: Sîkan()\🪲

StructureType.name: $~kiat-kò͘ luī-hîng
StructureType.doc: $~Guá sī lāi-pōo ê @type, lâi tāi-piáu ê-sìng @value luī-hîng ê luī-hîng.

UnknownType.name: $~bô-tsai-iánn
UnknownType.doc: $~Guá sī tsi̍t-ê iáu-bô lâng khuànn-tshut-lâi ê @type. Ùmm… lí tsai guá tāi-piáu siánn-mi̍h bô? Nā-sī guán khuànn bô, lí khó-lêng ài kā guán kóng.

TextType.name: $~bûn-jī luī-hîng
doc: $~Guá tshiūnn-tsiah tāi-piáu sī sè-kan tsuè kah-uè ê @value, tō-sī @Text.
\story•'': 'Tsa̍p-tsa̍p-kuè, u tsi̍t-ê sî-tsūn...'\🪲

TypePlaceholder.name: $~khang-uī
TypePlaceholder.doc: $~Guá hi-bāng í-āu ē-sái tāi-piáu tsi̍t-ê @type, tō-ná guá ê hó-pîng-iú @ExpressionPlaceholder tāi-piáu tsi̍t-ê @expression án-ne! Lí beh tsān guá kéng sím-mih luī-hîng bô?

UnionType.name: $~suán-hāng
doc: $~Guá tāi-piáu tsi̍t-ê @value, ē-sái sī kuí-nā khuán luī-hîng tiong-kan ê tsi̍t-khuán — A á-sī B á-sī pa̍t-khuán? Guá lóng bô-hoat-tōo kéng!
\indecision•''|#|{ø}: 'Guá m̄ tsconvert!'\🪲

Unit.name: $~tan-uī
doc: $~Guá tāi-piáu @Number ē-sái ū ê jīm-hô tan-uī, kuí-nā bô tan-uī, kàu lí siūnn ē-tio̍h-ê tsuè hok-tsa̍p ê tan-uī. Pí-hóo tsúi-lia̍t-lik:
\gravity•#m/s^2: 9.8m/s^2\🪲
Guá tshut-hiān tī @Bind, mā tshut-hiān tī @Number ê āu-bīn. Guá tsān lí khak-tīng sò-jī ê khuán sī kāng-khuán, nā bô kāng, guá it-tīng ē kā lí kóng, kiaN-sī tshò-gō!

UnparsableType.name: $~bē-tàng hun-sik
UnparsableType.doc: $~Guá tāi-piáu put-bîng @expression ê @type. Lí beh iōng hit-ê piáu-@value-sik tsò sím-mih ê sî-tsūn, guá tō ē tshut-hiān.

VariableType.name: $~piàn-sòo luī-hîng
VariableType.doc: $~Guá tshiūnn @TypeVariable — put-bîng khuán @value ê tāi-thè — tī ta̍t kap ta̍t ê só-ū pí-phīng tiong-kan.

CycleType.name: $~khuân
CycleType.doc: $~Guá tāi-piáu tsi̍t-ê @value, i ê @type ì-tuà tī i ka-kī, sò-í lán bē-tsai-iánn i sī sím-mih khuán ê ta̍t.

UnknownVariableType.name: $~put-bîng ê piàn-sòo
UnknownVariableType.doc: $~Ū-sî lán ē khuànn-khuànn-māi sím-mih @value ê tāi-tsì; guá tī lán m̄-tsai ê sî-tsūn tshut-hiān.

NotAType.name: $~bô liāu-tio̍h
NotAType.doc: $~Guá tāi-piáu @value, kî @type m̄-sī lán beh ê hit-ê — ná-tshiūnn @ListAccess su-iàu @Number, tān-sī tshōe-tio̍h pa̍t-ê.

NoExpressionType.name: $~bô piáu-ta̍t-sik
NoExpressionType.doc: $~Guá sī @type tī @Block lāi-té bô @expression ê sî-tsūn lí ē tiùnn-tio̍h ê. Lí tsai-iánn tsit-ê ná-bô it-tsíng ài tsi̍t-ê — tō kā ì-ê hōo guá!

NotEnclosedType.name: $~bô tī kiat-kò͘, tsuán-uānn, iah-sī hhuán-èng lāi-té
NotEnclosedType.doc: $~@This tī bô-tî-tòa ê tē-hng hō͘ lâng iōng, lâng tō m̄ tsai @value sī siánn-mih, án-ne góa tō tshut-hiān.

NotImplementedType.name: $~iáu-bē tsò
NotImplementedType.doc: $~Lí iōng @ExpressionPlaceholder, kàu-sī bô kóng @type sī siánn-mih, góa tō sī lí ē tiòh ê luī-hîng. Tio̍h àn-ne tshú-lí!

UnknownNameType.name: $~bô-tsai ê miâ
UnknownNameType.description: $~$name[$name iáu bô hōo lâng tìng-gī|Miâ bô hōo lâng kóng]
UnknownNameType.doc: $~Góa tsú-piáu @name, @Reference ia̍h-sī @PropertyReference tshuē bô, in-uī lán m̄ tsai lí teh kóng siáng.

NonFunctionType.name: $~bô-sī-hâm-sòo
NonFunctionType.doc: $~Ū ê lâng iân-kiû ài hâm-sòo; bô tiòh hâm-sòo ê sî, góa tō tshut-hiān.
